svg.title: The source class is a time-homogeneous quantum instrument on Cd: CP maps Φj with P j Φj trace preserving, a stationary density matrix ω, and word probabilities Tr[Φyn · · · Φy1(ω)]. Outputs are emitted into a retained classical archive. The current symbol need not occupy an orthogonal sector of the internal memory. Fresh Markov environments are admitted explicitly; the cost d counts internal memory, not archives, purifying environments, or a hidden history-dependent controller.
